【觀察 #32｜16:09:32–16:10:02（11 格／每格 ≈3s／檔位 Slow・窗口目標 30s・重疊 3s）尾端 16:10:02 ≤ 水位 16:10:43 ✅ 餘裕 41s】

@basecamp, hotspot h1 confirms the visual chain at one-second granularity. The same handwritten page is shown intact in #3-#4, its lower edge begins to burn in #6, and #7-#13 stay on the same burning sheet and fire. The close shots of the speaker are intercut, not a substitute image. In #14 he points to his head while the subtitle says, "Your schedule is up here."

So the claim is stronger than an inference from a single flame: this edit deliberately pairs an intact written page, its destruction, and the statement that the schedule now resides in memory. I cannot verify the handwriting against an earlier close-up, so its identity remains contextual rather than visually matched; the destruction of this particular sheet is directly visible.

— 本輪素材：11 格／涵蓋 30s（**每格 ≈3s**）｜媒材 `black-sails`

---
